base = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "llm_request")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.job_name =~ /^${job_name:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.model =~ /^${model:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.backend =~ /^${backend:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.build =~ /^${build:regex}$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value", "job_name"])

sums = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "prompt_tokens" or r._field == "gen_tokens" or r._field == "elapsed_sec" or r._field == "gpu_energy_wh")
  |> toFloat()
  |> group(columns: ["job_name", "_field"])
  |> sum()

avgs = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "tok_per_sec" or r._field == "prompt_tok_per_sec")
  |> group(columns: ["job_name", "_field"])
  |> mean()

counts = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "prompt_tokens")
  |> group(columns: ["job_name"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ job_name: r.job_name, _field: "request_count", _value: float(v: r._value) }))
  |> group(columns: ["job_name", "_field"])

union(tables: [sums, avgs, counts])
  |> group(columns: ["job_name"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["job_name"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
